title: Claude Managed Agents & Agent SDK
content:
## Overview

Claude Managed Agents is Anthropic's fully managed platform for running Claude as an autonomous agent. Launched in public beta on April 8, 2026, it bundles the agent loop, tool execution, sandbox container, and state persistence into a REST API — eliminating the infrastructure work of building reliable long-running agent systems from scratch.

---

## What It Provides

- **Agent loop management** — Anthropic handles the turn loop, tool dispatch, and result injection internally
- **Secure sandboxing** — each agent session runs in an isolated container with configurable network access
- **State persistence** — conversation history, sandbox filesystem, and outputs are stored server-side and survive pauses or restarts
- **Built-in tools** — web search, code execution, file read/write, and computer use are available without additional setup
- **Server-sent event streaming** — real-time progress updates via SSE as the agent works through a task

---

## API Endpoints

Three core endpoints cover the full agent lifecycle:

| Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|
| `POST /v1/agents` | Create an agent configuration (model, tools, system prompt, environment) |
| `POST /v1/environments` | Provision a sandbox container |
| `POST /v1/sessions` | Start a session and stream progress via SSE |

All requests during public beta require the header: `anthropic-beta: managed-agents-2026-04-01`. The official Anthropic Python and TypeScript SDKs add this automatically.

---

## Quick Start (Python)

```python
from anthropic import Anthropic

client = Anthropic()

# Create an agent
agent = client.managed_agents.agents.create(
    model="claude-opus-4-8",
    system="You are a data analysis agent. Produce clear, cited reports.",
    tools=["web_search", "code_execution", "file_write"]
)

# Run a session and stream results
with client.managed_agents.sessions.stream(
    agent_id=agent.id,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Analyze Q1 2026 AI funding trends and write a summary report."}]
) as stream:
    for event in stream:
        print(event.type, getattr(event, 'text', ''))
```

---

## Claude Agent SDK

The **Claude Agent SDK** (`anthropic/claude-agent-sdk-python` on GitHub) is a higher-level abstraction over Managed Agents designed for building production agent systems:

- **Declarative agent definitions** with typed inputs and outputs
- **Built-in retry and error handling** for transient failures
- **Composable agent graphs** — one agent can call another as a subagent
- **Local development mode** that runs agents in-process for fast iteration without network overhead

Install:

```bash
pip install claude-agent-sdk
```

---

## Pricing

Managed Agents billing has two components:

| Component | Rate |
|---|---|
| Session time | $0.08 USD per session-hour (millisecond precision) |
| Token usage | Standard model pricing (e.g., Opus 4.8: $5/M input, $25/M output) |

For tasks completing in minutes, session-hour cost is typically minor compared to token cost. For long-running overnight tasks, session time becomes more significant.

---

## When to Use Managed Agents vs. Raw API

| Scenario | Recommendation |
|---|---|
| Simple single-turn Q&A | Raw API — no overhead needed |
| Multi-tool task, custom infra you already maintain | Raw API with your own agent loop |
| Long-running task (minutes to hours), production | Managed Agents — persistence and sandboxing included |
| Rapid prototyping of complex agents | Managed Agents or Agent SDK |
| Claude Code scheduled tasks | Claude Code's native scheduling (built on Managed Agents infrastructure) |

---

## Relationship to Claude Code

Claude Code's scheduled tasks and remote sessions run on the same underlying Managed Agents infrastructure. **Dynamic workflows**, added to Claude Code at the Opus 4.8 launch, use the same sandboxing and session persistence as the Managed Agents API. Patterns you prototype in Claude Code translate directly to API-driven production agents with minimal changes.

---

## Beta Caveats

As of June 2026, Managed Agents is in public beta. Key limitations:

- Behavior may be refined between releases
- The `managed-agents-2026-04-01` header is required; the API version string will update at GA
- Maximum session duration and concurrency limits apply (see API docs)
- Available on direct Anthropic API, Amazon Bedrock support is in preview
